description.narrative: Planerad ny fas av statistiksamarbetet i Kosovo 2014-2017. Samarbetet mellan SCB och Kosovos statistikbyrå (Kosovo Agency of Statistics, KAS) började 2001. Samarbetet har varit framgångsrikt, men givet att Kosovo startade från en mycket låg nivå har det tagit tid att bygga upp den tekniska nivån. För att KAS ska nå upp till EU-standard, som är det långsiktiga målet, behövs ytterligare stöd efter denna period.
Planned new phase of Statistics cooperation in Kosovo 2014-2017.

Statistics Sweden has worked with the Kosovo Agency of Statistics (KAS) since 2001 in a total of four project phases, financed by the Swedish International Development Cooperation Agency (Sida). The last phase lasted from 2014-mid 2018 (prolonged from original end date December 2017). The project was set up in accordance with previous established models for SCB agency cooperation with long-term advisors (2 at the beginning of the project decreased to 1 in 2016) and an addition of additional experts joining the team in short term missions. A total of 73 short term missions involving 67 experts were conducted. In addition, 7 study visits/working missions were conducted . The project also supported a few KAS internal planning and monitoring workshops (such as annual and five-year plans). Furthermore, the project also supported participation in external project component-related activities in a few cases. Quarterly Steering Committee Meetings with participation from KAS, Statistics Sweden and Sida were held, as well as annual meetings. The overall objective of this project was to support KAS and the national statistical system in Kosovo towards building sound statistical methods and practices, in line with EU and international standards. The project has reached many results in line with its overall objective and has delivered a large number of outputs. Results per project component are generally satisfactory. The main components of the fourth project phase were: Economic and Agriculture Monetary Statistics Environment Statistics Social Statistics Information Technology (IT) and Methodology Dissemination/Analysis Management Some of the main achievements during the period included data produced, submitted and accepted by Eurostat, for instance regarding agriculture statistics, the Household Budget Survey and price statistics. The number of data points from Kosovo in Eurobase, Eurostat’s online dissemination database, increased significantly between 2014 and 2018 (from around 20 000 in 2014 to around 600 000 in 2018, not all of which can be attributed to project at hand). Some areas have fared very well, for example in agricultural statistics where KAS during the project period developed sufficient capacities to produce and analyse key agricultural statistics. In other areas, such as gender statistics, capacity development has been less notable but outputs still relevant valuable. These results are however less sustainable after the project timeline and indicate a certain degree of gap-filling by SCB expertise. Non-production oriented results included the setup of the new KAS website, greatly improving dissemination of and access to statistics. Overall support to IT proved necessary and vital for the achievement of all other outputs. The limited support to management development, Including the introduction of the time-management and planning tool SIPK has significant results.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
